links.text:
Snake Battle
    
Begin your journey as a diminutive worm and watch as you grow longer with every orb you devour, strewn across this expansive world. Your goal: slither and strategize your way through a treacherous landscape, outmaneuvering rivals, and seizing orbs to claim your dominance. Unleash your cunning tactics to outlast the competition, becoming the mightiest serpent in this epic battle. Challenge friends and foes alike, and let the thrill of the Snake Battle captivate your gaming senses. Will you emerge as the ultimate serpentine champion in this high-stakes showdown?
Play

Marble With Saga
    
Welcome to the captivating world of "Marble With Saga"! In this delightful game, your task is to launch cannonballs at matching-colored positions, creating satisfying chain reactions. As you eliminate beads, those of the same color in front and behind will merge, relieving your stress with each combination. It's a soothing and immersive experience that challenges your precision and strategy. Can you conquer the marbles and advance through the saga? Prepare to unwind, strategize, and enjoy the therapeutic thrill of "Marble With Saga." Relax and watch the marbles roll as you indulge in this delightful journey!
Play

Super Spy
    
Welcome to "Candy Shooter," where you play the role of a cunning spy with a sweet twist! Strategize your moves as you plan the launching angle of your candy bullets. Your mission is to eliminate as many soldiers as possible using the least number of shots. Keep a keen eye out for flammable and explosive items in your surroundings – they can be your allies in defeating the soldiers. Precision, strategy, and a taste for adventure are your best weapons in this candy-coated espionage mission. Are you up for the challenge? Become the ultimate candy spy in "Candy Shooter" and outsmart your enemies today!
Play

Realistic Parking
    
Challenge your parking skills in Realistic Parking! Navigate the car to the target parking space, controlling its direction as you move forward or backward. Maneuver through obstacles and test your precision in this realistic parking simulation."
Play

Shooting Cubes
    
Take aim as Shooting Cubes Tiny Cannon in this block-blasting adventure! Countless cubes advance, threatening to overrun the land. But Tiny Cannon dreams of becoming the next great Cannon Master. Armed with only a small shooter, you'll have to react quickly and accurately to explode the cubes. This humble cannon is your only defense against the relentless stampede. Level up your skills to access more powerful upgrades. Can you defeat enough cubes to earn the title of Cannon Master? Protect the kingdom in this fast-paced physics puzzler and fulfill your destiny!
Play

Make 24
    
Welcome to Make 24! Challenge your math skills in this exciting game. You'll be given four integers and a set of arithmetic operators, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Your task is to create an expression using these numbers and operators that evaluates to the number 24. Think it's easy? Try this: 1, 2, 7, 11. Can you find a combination that equals 24? Sharpen your problem-solving abilities and put your mathematical prowess to the test. Get ready to exercise your brain and show off your skills in Make 24!
Play
